messages:
maya: quick follow-up on safetensors warmup flakes. I sketched a sidecar + commit-lease + lazy-validate flow. Want quick opinions before RFC.

devin: short? we already debated canonical sidecars.

maya: tl;dr: ingest writes canonical-sidecar.vN.json + canonical-sidecar.vN.commit (contains version, header_digest_prefix, lease_id). Writer gets a short lease from control plane before renaming. Loader treats .commit as commit signal and can take a fast-path: cheap header prefix check then per-shard lazy checksum while streaming.

olga: commit file helps eventual-consistency tears. How do we avoid wrong offsets if header later mismatches?

maya: safety: sidecar includes per-shard offsets+checksums. Loader verifies each shard on first use; if any checksum fails, abort and fallback to legacy full-parse. Also background full-validate runs and emits metrics (lazy_ok, lazy_abort, lease_timeout).

harry: hotpatching?

maya: sidecar can include optional delta_manifest with base_digest and shard diffs. Loader applies patch only if base_digest matches current canonical digest. Patch application fetches affected shard ranges and swaps routing table atomically.

ci-bot: integration queued: feat/lazy-sidecar - tests for commit races.

devin: ops: need runbook for lease service and error codes (412 commit_missing, 428 lease_mismatch, 422 checksum_fail, 504 lease_rpc_timeout). Also cache sidecars at CDN with short TTL to reduce metadata ops.

olga: compatibility: loader fallback to legacy full-parse when commit absent. Dogfood behind feature flag on Dedicated first.

maya: will file RFC tomorrow with schema, ingest pseudocode, loader state machine, and test plan. Thanks, will post PR link when ready.
